term.label: Associated publication
term.definition: An identifier for a literature publication where the investigation is described. Use of DOIs is recommended.

term.label: Study identifier
term.definition: Identifier corresponding to the study

term.label: Observation unit identifier
term.definition: Identifier corresponding to the entity that is being observed

term.label: PETase observation unit type
term.definition: Object independently observed: a material preparation or an individual reaction vessel. Repeated readings of one vessel keep its identifier; independent reactors use distinct identifiers.

term.label: experimental subject name
term.definition: Human-readable name for the PETase subject being observed, such as an enzyme variant, substrate material, or enzyme-substrate pair. Reaction conditions and analytical methods belong in Assay rows.

term.label: enzyme sample identifier
term.definition: Reference to the Sample sample identifier for the enzyme material used in this reaction. Required for a reaction vessel; omit for a material preparation. Do not reference the optional material alias instead.

term.label: substrate sample identifier
term.definition: Reference to the Sample sample identifier for the PET or proxy material used in this reaction. Required for a reaction vessel; omit for a material preparation. Do not reference the optional material alias instead.

term.label: PETase material type
term.definition: Material class. Enzyme preparations may contain multiple components; record their identities and proportions in material composition.

term.label: enzyme identifier
term.definition: Optional material alias. Cross-sheet references use the mandatory Sample sample identifier, not this alias.

term.label: substrate identifier
term.definition: Optional material alias. Cross-sheet references use the mandatory Sample sample identifier, not this alias.

term.label: enzyme type
term.definition: Name or identifier of the PET hydrolase enzyme variant, including wild-type enzymes and engineered variants. Populated for enzyme_variant or enzyme_preparation materials.

term.label: enzyme mutation
term.definition: Amino acid substitutions in the enzyme variant using standard notation. Multiple mutations should be separated by '/'. Populated for enzyme_variant or enzyme_preparation materials.

term.label: enzyme organism source
term.definition: Source organism, engineered parent, or environmental library from which the enzyme scaffold was originally derived.

term.label: enzyme melting temperature
term.definition: Optional summary of an enzyme melting-temperature measurement. Record each determination, including method, conditions, uncertainty and evidence, as a material-characterisation Assay. Do not treat Tm as independent of measurement conditions.

term.label: enzyme melting temperature method
term.definition: Method used to determine enzyme melting temperature, such as differential scanning fluorimetry, circular dichroism, nanoDSF, or differential scanning calorimetry.

term.label: enzyme thermostability notes
term.example: Tm improved by +9.3 °C to +13.4 °C versus wild-type LCC
term.definition: Free-text enzyme thermostability details that cannot be represented as a single Tm value, such as relative increases, calcium effects, or stability rankings.

term.label: PET substrate type
term.definition: Type and origin of the PET or proxy substrate material. Include amorphous/crystalline state, commercial name, waste origin, or proxy substrate identity when reported.

term.label: substrate form factor
term.definition: Physical form of the PET substrate. Controlled vocabulary: powder | film | flake | nanoparticle | microplastic | fibre | pellet | preform | textile | soluble | other.

term.label: PET substrate source
term.definition: Supplier, commercial origin, waste-stream origin, bottle/preform source, or other provenance information for the substrate material.

term.label: PET substrate preprocessing
term.definition: Physical or thermal preprocessing applied to the PET substrate before enzymatic depolymerisation, including grinding, micronization, amorphization, washing, or thermal treatment.

term.label: PET crystallinity
term.definition: Percentage crystallinity of the PET substrate, usually measured by differential scanning calorimetry. This is a substrate material property and should be recorded on the substrate Sample row. This Sample field is an optional summary. Preserve each determination, material state, method and evidence in a material-characterisation Assay; background literature values are not sample measurements.

term.label: PET glass transition temperature
term.definition: Glass transition temperature (Tg) of the PET substrate material. Preserve first-heat and second-heat distinctions in notes when both are reported. This Sample field is an optional summary. Preserve each determination, material state, method and evidence in a material-characterisation Assay; background literature values are not sample measurements.

term.label: PET molecular weight
term.definition: Number-average or weight-average molecular weight of the PET substrate material, preserving whether Mn or Mw was reported. This Sample field is an optional summary. Preserve each determination, material state, method and evidence in a material-characterisation Assay; background literature values are not sample measurements.

term.label: enzyme sequence accession
term.definition: Versioned protein sequence accession or stable sequence reference. Mutations refer to this parent sequence and its residue numbering.

term.label: enzyme construct description
term.example: Example parent; His-tag; substitutions relative to the parent
term.definition: Parent sequence, substitutions, tags, fusion orientation and linkers defining the enzyme construct.

term.label: enzyme preparation
term.definition: Expression host, purification and formulation of the enzyme material; include purity or concentration method when reported.

term.label: material composition
term.definition: Components and their reported proportions, including polymer blends, fillers or enzyme mixtures. Preserve mass or molar basis.

term.label: material preparation identifier
term.definition: Reference to an earlier Sample from which this material or aliquot was prepared. Omit if unavailable.

term.label: material state
term.definition: State of the material at sampling, such as before reaction, after reaction, dry or hydrated.

term.label: reaction scale
term.definition: Experimental scale used during the assay/treatment applied to the PETase subject. Controlled vocabulary: microplate | flask | bottle | bioreactor | pilot_scale | industrial | not_reported | other.

term.label: reactor volume
term.definition: Total capacity of the vessel, including unit. Use reaction working volume for the volume of the reaction mixture; do not infer one from the other.

term.label: enzyme loading
term.definition: Amount of enzyme applied in the assay/treatment condition. Preserve the reported basis, such as mg enzyme/g PET, micromolar enzyme, mg/mL, or mass fraction.

term.label: substrate solid loading
term.definition: Concentration or fraction of PET substrate in the assay/treatment condition, reported as g/L, % w/w, g/kg, or the paper-specific basis (e.g. 1% w/w PET powder). The amount loaded, not the substrate identity, form or crystallinity.

term.label: buffer type
term.definition: Buffer system or reaction medium used in the assay/treatment condition. Controlled vocabulary: potassium phosphate | sodium phosphate | glycine-NaOH | glycine-OH | Tris-HCl | HEPES | borate | water | phosphate | citrate | acetate | carbonate | other.

term.label: buffer concentration
term.definition: Molar concentration of the reaction buffer when reported.

term.label: reaction pH
term.definition: pH of the assay/treatment condition. If pH is controlled dynamically, record the set point and describe control in reaction condition notes. When the source states only a span of pH values without enumerating them (e.g. 3–10), record the span as reported; do not invent individual levels.

term.label: reaction temperature
term.definition: Temperature at which the assay/treatment condition was conducted. Create separate Assay rows when the same PETase subject is tested at multiple temperatures. When the source states only a span of temperatures without enumerating them (e.g. 30–80), record the span as reported; do not invent individual levels.

term.label: agitation rate
term.definition: The speed of agitation or stirring in the vessel (rpm).

term.label: reaction time
term.definition: Total reaction duration, including its reported unit. Individual sampling times and rate-fitting windows are recorded separately.

term.label: actual PET vs proxy substrate
term.definition: Classification of the substrate used in this assay. Controlled vocabulary: actual_pet | proxy_substrate | not_applicable. Use not_applicable for measurements without a PET or proxy reaction; omit when unreported.

term.label: proxy substrate identity
term.definition: Identity of a soluble or fluorescent proxy substrate used instead of PET, such as BHET, MHET, pNPB, or BHET-OH. Leave empty for actual PET-only reactions.

term.label: depolymerisation measurement design
term.definition: Whether depolymerisation was followed as an endpoint, a time-resolved series, or both for this assay. Controlled vocabulary: endpoint | time_resolved | both. Omit when unreported.

term.label: reaction condition notes
term.example: pH regulated by NaOH addition; 75 °C tested but detrimental due to recrystallization
term.definition: Additional reaction-system details that affect interpretation, including pH-stat control, non-isothermal runs, recrystallization notes, or paper-specific condition caveats.

term.label: assay identifier
term.definition: Identifier that corresponds to this assay

term.label: assay name
term.example: UHPLC quantification of TPA equivalents after 24 h
term.definition: The name of this assay

term.label: PETase measurement category
term.definition: Type of measurement or reported reaction condition. Controlled vocabulary: product_quantification | activity | kinetics | material_characterisation | stability | reaction_condition | other.

term.label: analytical separation method
term.definition: Chromatographic or other separation method used before detection. Record HPLC, UHPLC, LC-MS, no separation, or column details when reported.

term.label: detection method
term.definition: Detector or readout used to quantify products or activity. Controlled vocabulary: absorbance | fluorescence | refractive_index | mass_spectrometry | NaOH_titration | pH_stat | gravimetric | other.

term.label: UV detection wavelength
term.definition: UV wavelength used for absorbance-based detection. PET monomers are often detected near 240-242 nm, while EG may use another wavelength.

term.label: analyte identity
term.definition: Identity of the analyte or product basis quantified by the Assay row. This is critical for comparing depolymerisation percentage, product concentration, and activity values.

term.label: measurement time point
term.definition: Time point at which the analytical measurement was taken, relative to reaction start. Required for time-resolved depolymerisation measurements.

term.label: PET depolymerisation percentage
term.definition: Percentage of PET substrate converted, solubilized, or degraded as reported by the analytical assay. Specify the analyte or calculation basis in analyte identity or measurement notes.

term.label: product concentration
term.definition: Concentration of depolymerisation products measured by the analytical assay, preserving the reported product basis and unit.

term.label: specific activity
term.definition: Specific activity derived from the measured reaction products per unit enzyme, including a Michaelis-Menten Vmax reported per mg enzyme (e.g. µmol·min^-1·mg^-1). Preserve the reported unit, product basis and ± error; use activity unit for normalization.

term.label: initial reaction rate
term.definition: Initial rate of product formation measured in the linear phase. This is not the same as space-time yield, endpoint depolymerisation percentage, or a fitted Vmax (use specific activity).

term.label: space-time yield
term.definition: Volumetric productivity. Distinguish enzyme-normalized productivity by retaining the enzyme-mass denominator. Record the averaging interval or maximum-rate basis.

term.label: activity unit
term.definition: Canonical unit category for activity or productivity values. Use this to normalize the highly variable activity unit strings in expert annotations.

term.label: catalytic rate constant kcat
term.definition: Conventional turnover number per enzyme, in s^-1, with an explicit kinetic model and substrate basis. Inverse-MM substrate-mass-normalized parameters must use measurement quantity inverse_turnover, preserving their reported units.

term.label: Michaelis constant Km
term.definition: Conventional Michaelis constant expressed as substrate concentration. For inverse Michaelis-Menten, the half-saturation concentration is enzyme concentration: use measurement quantity inverse_Km instead.

term.label: kinetic substrate basis
term.definition: Substrate used to derive kinetic parameters. Km and kcat measured on BHET, MHET, pNPB, or PET films are not directly comparable without this field.

term.label: kinetic model
term.definition: Kinetic model used to derive the reported parameters, such as Michaelis-Menten, substrate inhibition, interfacial kinetics, or empirical linear-rate model.

term.label: half inactivation temperature
term.definition: Temperature at which half of the enzyme activity remains after a specified incubation and assay protocol. Record the incubation duration and conditions. This temperature is not an activity half-life (a time), nor a melting temperature.

term.label: replicate count
term.definition: Positive integer number of replicates. Use PETase replicate type to distinguish independent reactions from repeated analytical measurements.

term.label: measurement uncertainty
term.definition: Uncertainty or error of the measured value, including type such as SD, SEM, 95% CI, and replicate count when reported.

term.label: measurement notes
term.example: Activity calculated from NaOH consumption between 10% and 90% conversion
term.definition: Additional notes about analytical methodology, calculation approach, normalization, data quality, or why a kinetic value is not comparable across studies.

term.label: measurement quantity
term.definition: Identity of the measured physical quantity. Inverse kinetic parameters are distinct from conventional ones. Use other only with an explicit reported parameter name.

term.label: measurement value
term.definition: Scalar numeric value in measurement unit. Preserve uncertainty separately. Omit for a range-only or missing result.

term.label: measurement unit
term.definition: Unit of this result; use 1 for a dimensionless ratio. Preserve the reported unit and normalization basis; use not reported if the source omits the unit.

term.label: measurement lower bound
term.definition: Lower limit of a reported interval, in measurement unit; do not invent its midpoint.

term.label: measurement upper bound
term.definition: Upper limit of a reported interval, in measurement unit.

term.label: reported parameter name
term.definition: Parameter symbol or name exactly identifying the reported quantity, particularly for model-specific parameters.

term.label: result material identifier
term.definition: Sample sample identifier of the material being characterised; different from a reaction aliquot if applicable.

term.label: measurement context
term.example: Example condition; record only source-reported details
term.definition: Conditions of this determination, including buffer, calcium, heating cycle, hydration, temperature or preparation state as applicable.

term.label: measurement uncertainty value
term.definition: Non-negative uncertainty magnitude, in the same unit as the result. Record interval limits separately.

term.label: measurement uncertainty type
term.definition: Meaning of uncertainty; do not assume SD when the source does not state it.

term.label: PETase replicate type
term.definition: Whether repetitions are independent reactions, technical measurements, or unspecified in the source.

term.label: measurement evidence type
term.definition: Source status of the result. Background/reference values must not be presented as measured properties of this sample.

term.label: measurement source DOI
term.definition: Publication providing evidence for this individual result.

term.label: measurement source location
term.definition: Main text or supplement and page/table/figure identifying the evidence.

term.label: reported measurement
term.definition: Source-reported value, unit and qualifiers, preserved before normalisation.

term.label: measurement conversion
term.definition: Conversion formula and original basis if measurement value or unit differs from the reported measurement.

term.label: measurement normalization basis
term.example: Per gram PET substrate; enzyme excess
term.definition: Denominator and material basis, including enzyme mass, PET mass, area or liquid volume; distinguish maxima from averages.

term.label: comparison assay identifier
term.definition: Assay identifier of the comparator for a relative result. If unavailable, describe it explicitly in comparison reference.

term.label: comparison reference
term.example: Wild-type enzyme under the same stated conditions
term.definition: Reported comparator identity and conditions when no linked comparator result is available.

term.label: rate fitting interval
term.definition: Start and end times and unit used to estimate the rate, distinct from total reaction duration.

term.label: quantification calibration
term.example: Calibration against an authentic analyte standard
term.definition: Standards, calibration method, blank subtraction and product-equivalent calculation when reported.

term.label: reaction working volume
term.definition: Volume of reaction mixture, with unit. Distinguish this from vessel capacity and identify compartments in measurement context.

term.label: reaction additives
term.definition: Additives with identities, amounts/units and dosing times. Repeated quantitative entries may use reaction_condition Assays.

term.label: reaction dosing schedule
term.example: Example: 5 mg enzyme at 36 h and 50 h
term.definition: Time, identity, amount and unit for each enzyme or reagent addition.

term.label: pH control
term.definition: Initial pH, permitted range, control method and titrant when reported.

term.label: mixing method
term.definition: Mixing device and mode; agitation rate alone does not define mixing conditions.

term.label: fluorescence excitation wavelength
term.definition: Excitation wavelength, when fluorescence is used.

term.label: fluorescence emission wavelength
term.definition: Emission wavelength, when fluorescence is used.
